answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before joining the shared meadow of trade, with the stake slashed if peers prove fake identities. Newcomers start at a wharf with limited throughput - small trades only - and earn higher limits through attested work history, so a gale of fresh sock-puppets gains nothing: each fake identity costs a full stake plus the time to build reputation, while honest agents keep their bond and limits grow.
